title: Deadpool Killed the Avengers. They Weren't His Real Target.
description: Why the heroes were not Deadpool’s final targets in Deadpool Kills the Marvel Universe #1–4 (2012), an alternate comic reality. Dark, non-graphic illustrated recap; not MCU continuity.
hook: Deadpool killed the Avengers. But they weren't his real target.
payoff: Then he turns toward the reader. After the heroes and their creators, we're next. For more stories like this, subscribe.

units.speaker: Host
units.text: Deadpool killed the Avengers. But they weren't his real target.
units.onscreen: THE HEROES WERE NOT THE FINAL TARGET
units.visual_query: THE HEROES WERE NOT THE FINAL TARGET

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: In Deadpool Kills the Marvel Universe, from 2012, Wade's mission starts with an attempt to control him.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Psycho-Man poses as a doctor and tries to brainwash him. Instead, a new voice convinces Wade his world is fiction, and everyone's suffering is entertainment.
units.onscreen: A NEW VOICE CHANGES THE MISSION
units.visual_query: A NEW VOICE CHANGES THE MISSION

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Wade decides killing the characters will free them. Stolen shrinking technology lets him smuggle explosives into the Avengers' headquarters.
units.onscreen: HE BELIEVES HE IS FREEING THEM
units.visual_query: HE BELIEVES HE IS FREEING THEM

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Hulk tears him apart. Wade regenerates, waits for Hulk to become Bruce Banner, then kills him.
units.onscreen: THE HULK FIGHT DOES NOT END THERE
units.visual_query: THE HULK FIGHT DOES NOT END THERE

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: But killing everyone only destroys the cast. It doesn't touch whoever controls their lives, so Wade needs a way outside the story.
units.onscreen: THE CAST IS NOT WHO CONTROLS THE STORY
units.visual_query: THE CAST IS NOT WHO CONTROLS THE STORY

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: At the Nexus of All Realities, a gateway between worlds, Wade reaches Man-Thing. The creature opens a portal, and Wade steps through.
units.onscreen: THE WAY OUT IS THROUGH THE NEXUS
units.visual_query: THE WAY OUT IS THROUGH THE NEXUS

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: On the other side, he finds people planning the very comic we're reading. His next targets are its writers and artists.
units.onscreen: THEY ARE PLANNING THIS VERY ENDING
units.visual_query: THEY ARE PLANNING THIS VERY ENDING

units.speaker: Host
units.text: Then he turns toward the reader. After the heroes and their creators, we're next. For more stories like this, subscribe.
units.onscreen: THE FINAL TARGET IS OUTSIDE THE PANEL
units.visual_query: THE FINAL TARGET IS OUTSIDE THE PANEL
